name: Imouto Piano ~Onii-chan no Ooki na Takt de Rhythm o Kizande!~
original_name: いもうと・ぴあの ～お兄ちゃんの大きなタクトでリズムを刻んで！～
source: My sister Ayaka got scared of her piano contest and ran out of the house. She always gets nervous before she plays. To remedy that our protagonist begins to giving her some special training.
translation: My sister Ayaka got scared of her piano contest and ran out of the house. She always gets nervous before she plays. To remedy that our protagonist begins to giving her some special training.
